title: ecbolium incanum
intro: Ecbolium incanum, commonly known as the "Tall Verbena", is a plant species in the family Acanthaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant are still being researched, but it is believed to contain flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
